headline: Upgrade pdfkit 0.11.0 → 0.21.0 (major)
steps: Upgrade pdfkit from 0.11.0 to 0.21.0; that release no longer pulls in a vulnerable crypto-js (major version: test carefully).
If pdfkit can't move yet, force crypto-js to 4.2.0 or later with an "overrides" entry.

headline: Pin uuid to 11.1.1 or later via overrides
steps: npm audit's only automatic fix is downgrading sequelize from 6.37.8 to 3.30.0. Don't do that: it rolls back other fixes.
Force uuid to 11.1.1 or later with an "overrides" entry in package.json, then run the tests.
Watch for a sequelize release that depends on a fixed uuid.
